name: Nifty 50 · 10 methods · daily race

methods.name: SMA 5/200
methods.desc: BUY when the 5-candle average closes above the 200-candle average (15-minute).
methods.why: Wins 32.0% of 228 trades; the average win +371.9 is 3.1x the average loss -121.0; profit factor 1.45; best trade +1,773.8; 2026 so far +2,734.8 points.
methods.formula: SMA5 = mean of the last 5 closes; SMA200 = mean of the last 200 closes, on 15-minute candles. BUY while SMA5 > SMA200 at a close, SELL while below. The flip order fills at the next 15-minute open. 0.035% of price per side.

methods.name: Supertrend 10/1.5
methods.desc: The real Pine Supertrend: Wilder ATR(10) bands at 1.5x that only tighten; flip when a 1-hour candle closes across the band.
methods.why: Wins 39.3% of 415 trades; the average win +272.5 is 2.0x the average loss -138.0; profit factor 1.28; best trade +2,376.3; 2026 so far +1,967.0 points.
methods.formula: TR = max(high, previous close) - min(low, previous close); ATR = Wilder average of TR over 10 one-hour candles. Bands = (high+low)/2 +- 1.5 x ATR; the upper band can only fall and the lower can only rise (ratchet). BUY while the close is above the line, flip when a 1-hour close crosses it. Fills at the next open; 0.035% per side.

methods.name: Close vs SMA 100
methods.desc: BUY when a 30-minute candle closes above its own 100-candle average, SELL below.
methods.why: Wins 22.5% of 364 trades; the average win +350.2 is 4.4x the average loss -79.4; profit factor 1.28; best trade +1,787.9; 2026 so far +1,260.4 points.
methods.formula: SMA100 = mean of the last 100 closes on 30-minute candles. BUY while the close is above its SMA100, SELL while below. Fills at the next open; 0.035% per side.

methods.name: Donchian 55
methods.desc: BUY when a close beats the highest close of the previous 55 candles, SELL when it breaks the lowest (15-minute).
methods.why: Wins 39.4% of 218 trades; the average win +347.3 is 1.9x the average loss -184.8; profit factor 1.22; best trade +2,107.5; 2026 so far +4,339.0 points.
methods.formula: HH = highest close of the previous 55 fifteen-minute candles; LL = lowest. A close above HH flips to BUY; a close below LL flips to SELL; in between, keep the current side. Fills at the next open; 0.035% per side.

methods.name: EMA 21/105
methods.desc: BUY when EMA 21 closes above EMA 105 (15-minute).
methods.why: Wins 35.6% of 216 trades; the average win +379.0 is 2.2x the average loss -172.6; profit factor 1.22; best trade +1,768.3; 2026 so far +1,947.4 points.
methods.formula: EMA with a = 2/(n+1): EMA_t = a x close + (1-a) x EMA_(t-1) (TradingView seeding), n = 21 and 105, on 15-minute candles. BUY while EMA21 > EMA105 at a close, SELL while below. Fills at the next open; 0.035% per side.

methods.name: Fable Council
methods.desc: Created by Fable: at every 15-minute close the five classics vote BUY or SELL; the majority side is the trade.
methods.why: Wins 32.5% of 274 trades; the average win +341.3 is 2.8x the average loss -123.7; profit factor 1.33; best trade +1,857.8; 2026 so far +2,660.1 points.
methods.formula: Created by Fable. At every 15-minute close each of the 5 classics gives s = +1 (BUY) or -1 (SELL); vote = s1+s2+s3+s4+s5. BUY while vote > 0, SELL while vote < 0 (five voters, so never a tie). Fills at the next open; 0.035% per side.

methods.name: Fable Twin Pulse
methods.desc: Created by Fable: the 1-hour Supertrend and the 30-minute close-vs-SMA-100 must point the same way; while they argue, the last agreed side is held.
methods.why: Wins 35.2% of 196 trades; the average win +397.6 is 2.5x the average loss -161.9; profit factor 1.33; best trade +1,690.1; 2026 so far +568.3 points.
methods.formula: Created by Fable. a = the Supertrend 10/1.5 side on 1-hour candles; b = the close-vs-SMA100 side on 30-minute candles. When a = b, take that side; while they disagree, hold the last agreed side. Checked at every 15-minute close; fills at the next open; 0.035% per side.

methods.name: Fable Quorum
methods.desc: Created by Fable: flip only when at least 4 of the 5 classics agree; anything less holds the previous side.
methods.why: Wins 37.2% of 172 trades; the average win +412.9 is 2.3x the average loss -183.4; profit factor 1.33; best trade +1,700.5; 2026 so far +1,850.2 points.
methods.formula: Created by Fable. The same vote as the Council. Flip to BUY only when vote >= +3 (at least 4 of 5 agree), to SELL only when vote <= -3; anything in between holds the previous side. Fills at the next open; 0.035% per side.

methods.name: Fable Heartbeat
methods.desc: Created by Fable: count the last 155 one-hour candles; more up-closes than down-closes means BUY, fewer means SELL.
methods.why: Wins 34.5% of 110 trades; the average win +411.3 is 2.9x the average loss -140.9; profit factor 1.54; best trade +2,688.7; 2026 so far +3,241.2 points.
methods.formula: Created by Fable. count = (up-closes) - (down-closes) over the last 155 one-hour candles. BUY while count > 0, SELL while count < 0, hold on zero. Fills at the next open; 0.035% per side.

methods.name: Fable Centreline
methods.desc: Created by Fable: BUY above the centre of the last 55 one-hour candles' range ((highest high + lowest low) / 2), SELL below.
methods.why: Wins 25.5% of 286 trades; the average win +377.2 is 3.5x the average loss -108.2; profit factor 1.2; best trade +1,861.9; 2026 so far +1,419.6 points.
methods.formula: Created by Fable. mid = (highest high + lowest low of the last 55 one-hour candles) / 2. BUY while the close is above mid, SELL while below. Fills at the next open; 0.035% per side.

livetest.name: Fable Twin Pulse
rules: PASS at trade 60: cumulative better than +4,672 points (95% one-sided vs the coin-flip).
FAIL: cumulative below zero at trade 60.
Anything else: inconclusive, the test extends to 120 trades.
Expected path if the backtest is true: +35.1 points per trade, band 1.96 x 367 x sqrt(trades).
Rules frozen on 10 Nov 2026, before the first live trade. They do not move.

limits: All ten were picked after looking at this same history; their honest shared out-of-sample record starts 10 Nov 2026.

CORRECTION 11 Nov 2026: a lookahead bug in the ensemble timeframe mapping was found and fixed. Twin Pulse fell from +22,581 to about +9,016 points, Council from +19,185 to about +9,779, Quorum from +11,017 to about +8,757. The ranking you see uses only the corrected, causal numbers.
The Fable ensembles (Council, Quorum, Twin Pulse) reuse the five classics, so they inherit their selection bias too.
Two more Fable inventions - close vs rolling median, and the regression-slope sign - were tested the same way and REJECTED because they lost money. Only survivors are shown.
Supertrend 10/1.5 was chosen from 30 period/multiplier/timeframe combinations, so treat its edge as the least proven.
Fills are assumed exactly at each next open; positions are held overnight.
